verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer page lists search as one of the features apps can add through the DBX Platform, so a first-party search API exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it reaches inside file contents rather than only matching names. Dash's cross-app knowledge search is an end-user product, not a documented developer API, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented search endpoint reference, evidence of full-text content search via the API, filename/metadata query semantics beyond prefix matching, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, search reaches inside files — a documented search API over filenames and full-text content, not just prefix matching

citations.quote: the DBX Platform lets you add Dropbox features to your apps, such as file storage, sharing, previews, and search.
